title: Taiwanese Beef Noodle Soup
description: Tender beef shank in a rich, slightly spicy broth with fresh noodles, bok choy, pickled mustard greens, scallions, and cilantro. Instant Pot or stovetop.

items.note: snow vegetable / 雪菜, to taste

steps.text: Boil the beef shank chunks for 1 minute, then drain and rinse thoroughly to remove impurities.
On the Instant Pot sauté setting, cook the oil, ginger, garlic, scallions, and onion until the onion is translucent. Add the tomato and dried chilies.
Add the beef, tomato paste, spicy bean paste, sugar, soy sauce, and Shaoxing wine, and mix thoroughly.
Pour in 8 cups of water and add the spice packet. Do not fill the Instant Pot more than two-thirds full; halve the recipe for a smaller cooker.
Pressure-cook 100 minutes on Meat/Stew with the vent sealed. On the stove, simmer 3–4 hours instead.
Release the pressure carefully. Boil the noodles according to the package, and blanch the bok choy in the noodle water for the last 1–2 minutes.
Serve the broth and beef over noodles with bok choy, cilantro, scallions, and pickled mustard greens.

notes: Stovetop option: simmer 3–4 hours instead of pressure-cooking.
